name: git_namespaces
description:
List Git namespaces for a Git provider (github, github-limited, github-custom-host, gitlab, or bitbucket). If provider is omitted, it is derived from the authenticated user. Use host for a custom Git host and viewerMetadata to include the viewer object for each namespace.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/integrations/git-namespaces --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

host.description: The custom Git host if using a custom Git provider, like GitHub Enterprise Server

viewerMetadata.description: When true, includes the viewer object for each namespace.
